name: Active Tags
description: Enhanced tag widget for free tagging vocabularies.

suggests.drupal/webform: Adds an 'Entity autocomplete (Active Tags)' Webform element.
suggests.drupal/facets: Adds an Active Tags facet widget for faceted search.
suggests.drupal/better_exposed_filters: Adds an Active Tags widget for Views exposed filters.

bundled_js_library: Tagify-derived tag-input library (Drupal.ActiveTags), bundled locally; no CDN
project_description:
Enhance your Drupal entity reference fields with an intuitive tags input widget. This widget seamlessly integrates with the Drupal Entity Autocomplete, providing a user-friendly tagging experience and optimizing performance for smoother and more efficient interactions.

Active Tags turns any entity_reference (or entity_reference-backed taxonomy) field into an interactive chip/pill widget: each referenced entity becomes a removable token, suggestions are fetched from a dedicated autocomplete endpoint, matched letters are highlighted, tags can be drag-reordered, duplicates are blocked, and (for user references) avatars and optional entity-id / info-label decorations can be shown. It ships two field widgets ('Autocomplete (Active Tags)' = entity_reference_autocomplete_active_tags, and 'Select (Active Tags)' = select_active_tags), two matching Form-API render elements, and integration plugins for Webform, Facets and Better Exposed Filters. The client is a bundled Tagify-derived library (Drupal.ActiveTags) plus an init script; all JS/CSS is local with theme variants for Claro, Gin and Seven.
